leadText:
The Baker Detective Agency (Japanese: ベイカー Baker Detective Agency) is a detective agency based in Ryme City in the game . Their offices are located on the second floor of a building south of Tahnti Park, above the Hi-Hat Café. It is first visited at the end of Chapter 1.

The director of the agency is Mike Baker, who is assisted by Amanda Blackstone.
